page: Language Detector Middleware for automatic language/locale detection. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {languageDetector} from 'hono/language'. Access detected language: c.get('language'). Detection sources: query parameters (?lang=ar), cookies (language=ja), Accept-Language header, URL path segments (/ar/home). Default detection order: querystring, cookie, header. Progressive locale matching: ja-JP matches ja if ja-JP unsupported, zh-Hant-CN matches zh-Hant then zh. Default fallback: 'en'. Cache language in cookie: 1 year expiration. Options: supportedLanguages (required, string[] array), fallbackLanguage (required, must be in supportedLanguages), order (optional, DetectorType[] default ['querystring','cookie','header']), lookupQueryString (optional, default 'lang'), lookupCookie (optional, default 'language'), lookupFromHeaderKey (optional, default 'accept-language'), lookupFromPathIndex (optional, default 0), convertDetectedLanguage (optional, function for normalization), caches (optional, CacheType[] | false, default ['cookie']), cookieOptions (optional, path, sameSite, secure, maxAge, httpOnly, domain), ignoreCase (optional, boolean, default true), debug (optional, boolean, default false). HTTP header: Accept-Language. BCP 47 language tags support. Validation: errors on invalid config. Questions: How to detect language? Which detection methods available? How to set supported languages? Language Detector basic usage. languageDetector({supportedLanguages: ['en', 'ar', 'ja'], fallbackLanguage: 'en'}). Detects from query, cookie, header in default order. Access with c.get('language'). Client examples: path /ar/home, query ?lang=ar, cookie (Cookie: language=ja), header (Accept-Language: ar,en;q=0.9). Returns detected language code or fallback. Questions: How to detect language? What formats work? How to get result? What's the default detection order? Can I try examples?

Default Language Detector options and configuration constants. DEFAULT_OPTIONS exported. order: ['querystring', 'cookie', 'header'] detection sequence. lookupQueryString: 'lang' for query parameter name. lookupCookie: 'language' for cookie name. lookupFromHeaderKey: 'accept-language' for header name. lookupFromPathIndex: 0 for path segment index (/en/profile → 'en' at index 0). caches: ['cookie'] stores detected language. ignoreCase: true case-insensitive matching. fallbackLanguage: 'en' default language. supportedLanguages: ['en'] default supported. cookieOptions: {sameSite: 'Strict', secure: true, maxAge: 365*24*60*60, httpOnly: true} cookie configuration. debug: false disables logging. Questions: What are default values? How to override? Can I change detection order? What cookie options exist? How to debug?

Language Detector key behaviors and workflow. Detection workflow: 1) Check sources in order (query, cookie, header default), 2) Cache result in cookie (1 year), 3) Use fallbackLanguage if no valid detection. Order: querystring (?lang=ar), cookie (language=ar), Accept-Language header. Caching: stored in cookie by default, prevents re-detection. Fallback: uses fallbackLanguage when detection fails, must be in supportedLanguages. Questions: In what order are sources checked? How is language cached? What happens if no language detected? How long is language cached?

Language Detector advanced configuration options. Custom detection order: order: ['path', 'cookie', 'querystring', 'header'] prioritizes URL path. lookupFromPathIndex: specifies path segment index (/en/profile → index 0 = 'en'). Progressive locale matching: ja-JP not in supported → tries 'ja'. Example: zh-Hant-CN tries zh-Hant then zh. convertDetectedLanguage: (lang) => lang.split('-')[0] normalizes codes (en-US → en). Cookie configuration: path ('/'), sameSite ('Lax'|'Strict'|'None'), secure (true), maxAge (86400*365 = 1 year), httpOnly (true), domain ('.example.com' optional). Disable caching: caches: false skips cookie storage. Debug: debug: true logs detection steps like 'Detected from querystring: ar'. Questions: How to prioritize path? What's progressive matching? Can I normalize codes? How to customize cookies? How to disable caching? Can I debug?

Language Detector options reference table. Basic options: supportedLanguages (string[], required, allowed codes), fallbackLanguage (string, required, default language), order (DetectorType[], default ['querystring','cookie','header'], detection sequence), debug (boolean, default false, enable logging). Detection options: lookupQueryString (string, default 'lang', query param name), lookupCookie (string, default 'language', cookie name), lookupFromHeaderKey (string, default 'accept-language', header name), lookupFromPathIndex (number, default 0, path segment). Cookie options: caches (CacheType[] | false, default ['cookie']), cookieOptions.path (string, default '/'), cookieOptions.sameSite ('Strict'|'Lax'|'None', default 'Strict'), cookieOptions.secure (boolean, default true), cookieOptions.maxAge (number seconds, default 31536000 = 1 year), cookieOptions.httpOnly (boolean, default true), cookieOptions.domain (string, optional). Advanced options: ignoreCase (boolean, default true, case-insensitive), convertDetectedLanguage ((lang) => string, normalize codes). Questions: Which options required? What are all defaults? What's each option for? Can I combine options?

Language Detector validation and error handling. Validation rules: fallbackLanguage must be in supportedLanguages or throws error. lookupFromPathIndex must be >= 0 or throws error. Invalid configurations throw errors during middleware initialization (not runtime). Error behavior: throws on setup, doesn't throw on detection failure. Detection failure behavior: silently uses fallbackLanguage, doesn't throw or log unless debug:true. Questions: What configurations throw errors? When do errors occur? What if detection fails? Does it throw on bad language? What's the error behavior?

Language Detector common recipes and patterns. Path-based routing: app.get('/:lang/home', (c) => {const lang = c.get('language'); return c.json({message: getLocalizedContent(lang);});}). Access language from route parameter context. Multiple supported languages: supportedLanguages: ['en', 'en-GB', 'ar', 'ar-EG']. Regional variants support. convertDetectedLanguage: (lang) => lang.replace('_', '-') normalizes underscores to hyphens. BCP 47 format compliance. Locale matching: ja-JP header matches 'ja' in supported, zh-Hant-CN matches 'zh-Hant'. Questions: How to do path-based routing? Can I support regional variants? How to normalize format?
